questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the word "Cumbersome" in the given sentence and choose the correct option.**

The new software is convenient and simple to use compared to the old one, which was very cumbersome.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1) i.e. 'Convenient'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**cumbersome**" means large or heavy and therefore difficult to carry or use; unwieldy. (बड़ा या भारी और इसलिए ले जाने या उपयोग करने में कठिन)

 
 
• **Example**: The cumbersome suitcases were hard to handle.
 
 
 
• **Convenient**: (सुविधाजनक) - fitting in well with a person's needs, activities, and plans.
 
 
• **Example**: The new arrangement is much more convenient for everyone.
 
 
 
• This word is a precise antonym for "**cumbersome**," as it indicates something easy and **convenient** to use.

**Therefore, the correct answer is "Convenient".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bulky**: (भद्दा) - taking up much space, typically inconvenient.
 
• **Unwieldy**: (अकुशल) - difficult to carry or move due to its size or shape.
 
• **Heavy**: (भारी) - of great weight; difficult to lift or move.

37:Te16,

The correct answer is **Option 1.**

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in a sentence.

The company has been forced to sell land to __recoup__ some of the losses.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Lose**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"recoup"** means to regain or recover something lost, often money or resources. (पुनः प्राप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The company hopes to recoup its investment within the next year.
 
 
 
• **"Lose"** refers to being deprived of or ceasing to have or retain something. (खोना)
 
 
• **Example: **He stands to lose a lot of money if the deal falls through.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'recoup'** is **'lose'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Lose**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ignore** (अनदेखा करना): Refuse to take notice of or acknowledge.

 
 
• **Example:** She chose to ignore the warning signs and continued with her plan.
 
 
 
• **Restart** (पुनः आरंभ करना): To start again or begin anew.
 
 
• **Example: **He had to restart his computer to install the updates.
 
 
 
• **Overlook** (नज़रअंदाज़ करना): Fail to notice something.
 
 
• **Example:** It’s easy to overlook minor details when you’re under pressure.

questions.question: Choose the antonym of "amusement"
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Melancholy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Amusement"** means the state or experience of finding something entertaining or enjoyable. (मनोरंजन)

 
 
• **Example: **The children were full of amusement as they played in the park.
 
 
 
• **"Melancholy"** refers to a feeling of deep sadness or gloom, which is the opposite of amusement. (उदासी)
 
 
• **Example: **After hearing the tragic news, a sense of melancholy filled the room.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the antonym of **'amusement'** is **'melancholy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 - Melancholy**.

• **Example: **The naughty puppy chewed up my shoes.
 
 
 
• **Hilarity **(प्रसन्नता): Extreme amusement, especially when expressed by laughter.
 
 
• **Example:** The comedian’s jokes filled the room with hilarity.
